card.title: How to fix iPhone 11 stuck in recovery mode with failed at Rose Error -1

source.title: How to fix iPhone 11 stuck in recovery mode with failed at Rose Error -1

claims.statement: iPhone 11 / 11 Pro stuck in recovery, failing a 3uTools flash around 90% with error -1, is usually the Rose IC not being detected.
On iPhone 11 (non-Pro) Rose is on the bottom board, so sandwich separation can cause it; test the split boards in an iSocket: if flashing succeeds, reball the interposer; if not, replace Rose.
On 11 Pro / Pro Max Rose sits on the top board, so the fault is almost always the IC itself.

procedure: Inspect for liquid, warping or layer separation.
Non-Pro: separate layers and test in iSocket; reball interposer if it then flashes.
Otherwise replace Rose IC with a donor; restore and test Wi-Fi, LTE, Face ID.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
